style: Photorealistic editorial still-life photograph for a premium travel brand, warm, quiet and natural, magazine quality. Restrained palette: ivory linen, deep teal (#008AA3) accents, weathered ochre, soft brick red, blossom pink. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no brand names, no watermarks.

images.prompt:
[SUBJECT] Overhead flat lay on a softly crumpled ivory linen tablecloth: a vintage silver-and-black 35mm rangefinder film camera with a brown leather strap and no brand markings; two instant-film prints with thick white borders showing softly blurred warm ochre street scenes; a small stack of five 4x6 photo prints tied with a thin deep-teal silk ribbon; a sprig of pink peach blossom; a small cream envelope closed with a plain brick-red wax seal without any emblem. Objects sit loosely along the lower edge and the right side; the upper-left and upper-right corners and the centre-left stay calm, empty linen.
[MATERIAL AND TEXTURE] Real paper fibres, visible linen weave, faint wear on the camera's metal and leather; natural imperfections, no CGI smoothness.
[LIGHTING] Soft directional window light from the upper left, late afternoon, about 4500K; gentle, long, soft shadows; low contrast; no clipped highlights.
[ENVIRONMENT] Tabletop only, seen from directly above; warm, calm, gift-like birthday mood.
[CAMERA SIMULATION] Medium-format digital camera, 80mm lens, overhead at exactly 90 degrees, f/8, ISO 100, 1/125s; subtle Kodak Portra 400 colour and fine film grain.
[DEPTH CONTROL] Everything sharp edge to edge at f/8; no tilt-shift, no bokeh, no blurred foreground.
[AVOID] No hands or people; no text on prints or envelope; no logos on the camera; no balloons, cake or confetti; no glossy plastic look, no oversaturation, no heavy vignette.
